identity.name: AnOrdain Model 1 Midnight Fumé
identity.one_liner: A Thailand-based microbrand built around a single product: a 38mm steel dress watch with a hand-fumed gradient dial. One of the most-cited fumé dials in the microbrand collector world.

narrative.story: AnOrdain is the only watch brand in the Time Pop register that is headquartered in northern Thailand. The Model 1 is the brand's single product: a 38mm steel dress watch with a hand-fumed gradient dial (each dial is fumed individually in a small kiln, with the gradient hand-painted in the workshop). The brand is run by a former graphic designer who has said in interviews that the dial-fuming process was the only reason the brand exists. The Model 1 is one of the most-cited fumé-dial watches in the microbrand collector community, with each fumé variant (Midnight, Petrol, Teal, Plum) limited to 50–100 pieces per dial color.
narrative.collector_notes: Each dial is hand-fumed over an open flame, then lacquered. The 38mm case is a manually-finished Chinese-made case sourced through a small Bangkok atelier. The movement is decorated with perlage on the rotor. The brand operates on a direct-order model with a 4-month waitlist per dial variant.
